versions.short: The bill would require the Secretary of the Interior to issue a right-of-way along the Blue Ridge Parkway for an emergency exit road near milepost 9.6, as shown on a map dated September 2024. The Secretary would have to first report to Congress that alternatives not crossing federal land, including converting existing trails into roads, have been evaluated. The Secretary would also need to report that an analysis of how fire would likely behave during an emergency has been completed. Finally, the Secretary would need to confirm that required environmental and historic preservation reviews for the right-of-way have been finished.
